Press and hold the spring in the bottom-right corner, then let go: the ball shoots out. A quick tap launches it too.
Tap the left half of the screen for the left flipper and the right half for the right flipper. You can use both thumbs at once.
Hit bumpers, targets and ramps. Fast consecutive hits build a combo. Don't let the ball slip between the flippers! A ball that drains in the first seconds after launch is saved once.
Complete the goal at the top. Gems depend on your score, balls left and bonus goals.
Every 10 levels open a new world: earth, water, fire, ice, storm, desert, dragon, cyber space, cosmos and core. In Endless mode on the main menu, chase your record until the balls run out.

Press and hold the spring lane at the bottom right, then let go: the longer you hold, the harder the ball launches. A quick tap launches it at normal power. Touching anywhere around the lane works, you don't have to hit the spring exactly.
Tap the left half of the screen to raise the left flipper and the right half for the right flipper. You can use both thumbs at the same time.

Hit different elements such as bumpers, targets and ramps, with no more than 3 seconds between hits. Each new, different element raises the combo one level (up to ×5) and each level adds 50% to your points, so at ×5 they are tripled. Hitting the same element twice in a row doesn't raise the level but refreshes the timer. If 3 seconds pass without a hit, the combo resets.
Every 2 sets you complete (target sets, drop-target sets or lane sets) raise the multiplier by one, from 1X up to 4X. It applies to all your points and works together with the combo.

On some levels, completing a certain number of sets or ramp shots starts special mode: for a limited time, every point you score is multiplied by an extra factor. When the time is up, scoring goes back to normal. Some levels also award an extra ball in the same way.
If the ball drains within the first few seconds after launch, it is saved once and you launch again without losing a ball. The Saver badge at the top shows this.

Each level has 3 gems: finishing the level gives the 1st, reaching the goal score the 2nd, and completing the bonus goal (for example, keeping spare balls or building a certain combo) the 3rd. Balls left when you finish give bonus points.
Pick the Classic or Modern table from the main menu and play until the balls run out. The aim is the highest score; each table keeps its own record.
